entities.name: Rosetta Sherwood Hall
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rosetta Sherwood Hall was an American medical missionary and educator. She founded the Pyongyang School for the Deaf and Blind. Hall spent forty-four years in Korea, helping develop educational resources for disabled Koreans and implementing women's medical training.
